description: As a fleet manager, I want to update the operational status of an aircraft so that the fleet status board reflects current conditions.

acs.text: The status form allows the user to select from Active, Grounded, or In Maintenance.
A confirmation dialog is shown before the status change is committed.
An error message is displayed if the status update fails due to a server error.
After a successful update, the status badge on the aircraft detail view reflects the new status immediately.

out_of_scope: Error handling and error messages are out of scope for this story — error states will be handled in a separate error-handling epic.
API timeout and retry logic are not covered in this iteration.
